say:1:1130509001:1.text: Ah, well any news big or small is welcome!
say:1:1130509001:1.source_cn: 唉，有点消息也行，我可以付钱！
say:1:1130509001:1.male: Ah, well any news big or small is welcome!
say:1:1130509001:1.female: Ah, well any news big or small is welcome!

say:2:1130509002:1.text: Where could they have disappeared? Did they abandon our business to hunt treasure together?
say:2:1130509002:1.source_cn: 怎么就忽然不见了呢？难道是抛下我们的生意，俩人结伴去寻宝了？
say:2:1130509002:1.male: Where could they have disappeared? Did they abandon our business to hunt treasure together?
say:2:1130509002:1.female: Where could they have disappeared? Did they abandon our business to hunt treasure together?

say:3:1130509003:1.text: I've heard of those bandits roaming about—the Quicksand Claws. I hope they haven't run into trouble with them...
say:3:1130509003:1.source_cn: 听说这里的强盗组织流沙之爪在到处抓人，他们不会出事吧……
say:3:1130509003:1.male: I've heard of those bandits roaming about—the Quicksand Claws. I hope they haven't run into trouble with them...
say:3:1130509003:1.female: I've heard of those bandits roaming about—the Quicksand Claws. I hope they haven't run into trouble with them...

say:4:1130509004:1.text: As it stands, I can't just abandon these goods to look for them. I really hope they return.
say:4:1130509004:1.source_cn: 唉，我又不能抛下货物去找人，希望他们能自己回来。
say:4:1130509004:1.male: As it stands, I can't just abandon these goods to look for them. I really hope they return.
say:4:1130509004:1.female: As it stands, I can't just abandon these goods to look for them. I really hope they return.
